title: HMO properties drive landlord yields above 7% in Q2 2026
summary:
Average landlord gross rental yields in the UK reached 7.02% in the second quarter of 2026, according to data from Paragon Bank, with houses in multiple occupation leading the growth. The figures represent the final quarterly data released before the introduction of the Renters' Rights Act.

title: Rightmove webinar to address property fall-throughs
summary:
Rightmove is hosting a webinar on 23 July focused on strategies to reduce property transaction fall-throughs. Research shows 80% of movers prioritise communication over transaction speed when recommending agents.

title: Majority of tenants support rent controls, survey finds
summary:
More than 80% of tenants support the introduction of rent controls as Prime Minister Andy Burnham considers reform of the rental market, according to new survey data. A survey of 5,607 tenants conducted by SpareRoom this month revealed widespread backing for the policy, though industry bodies warn the measure could reduce housing supply.

title: Estate agents fear retaliation in Rightmove legal dispute
summary:
Estate agents are expressing concern about potential commercial repercussions if they provide evidence in a £1.5 billion class action lawsuit against Rightmove, according to testimony presented at the Competition Appeal Tribunal. Lawyers representing the claimants stated that a significant number of agents are worried about adverse commercial consequences.

title: Majority of UK homes failed to see annual price growth
summary:
Only 14% of British homes have increased in value every year over the past five years, according to Zoopla analysis. The portal attributes the decline in consistent growth to higher mortgage costs, with northern regions proving more resilient than southern markets.

title: Winkworth appoints franchise operations lead
summary:
Winkworth has appointed Jack Spellman as its Franchise Operations Lead, a role that will see him work directly with the estate agency's network of more than 100 franchisees across the UK. Spellman brings experience from multiple property sector roles spanning residential sales and lettings operations.

title: BBC investigation exposes rental fraud by criminal gangs
summary:
A BBC Panorama investigation has revealed how criminal gangs are using fraudulent identities and references to secure rental properties, leaving landlords facing lengthy legal battles and significant financial losses. The programme documented cases where properties were converted into drugs factories and brothels.

title: Fine & Country YouTube channel reaches 200,000 subscribers
summary:
Estate agency network Fine & Country has reached 200,000 subscribers on its YouTube channel, doubling its audience within 12 months. The network's channel generated more than nine million views and 74.3 million impressions during the year to July 2026.

title: John Healey appointed Chancellor amid property tax speculation
summary:
John Healey has been appointed as the new Chancellor of the Exchequer in Prime Minister Andy Burnham's cabinet, replacing Rachel Reeves. Speculation has intensified around potential property tax reforms, including a Land Value Tax system.
